observations: Photo 0: Top lid of a chest freezer with significant brown and yellow discoloration, scratches, and peeling surface. The lid appears warped and damaged. The body is grey plastic with visible scuffs.
Photo 1: Side view of the freezer with lid partially open. The exterior is grey plastic with minor dirt and scuffs. A box is visible inside the freezer.

Photo 2: Interior view of the freezer showing a box labeled 'KENWOOD', various kitchen items (pot lid, remote, utensils), and a white cord. The interior lining is grey and appears dirty with debris. No brand or model visible on the freezer itself.
No visible brand or model name on the freezer in any photo.
The freezer is in a cluttered indoor space, possibly a storage area.

claims.claim: Neatly used Skyrun freezer in excellent condition
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows severe discoloration, peeling, and damage to the lid. Photo 2 shows a dirty interior with debris and unrelated items. The exterior in Photo 1 has visible scuffs and dirt. These conditions contradict 'excellent condition'. The brand 'Skyrun' is not visible in any photo, so the brand claim is unverified.

risks.risk: Freezer may not be functional or may have internal damage (e.g., compressor, cooling system)
risks.proof: Video or photo of the freezer running, showing temperature inside, or a close-up of the compressor and power cord.

risks.risk: Interior damage or mold due to visible debris and dirt
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the interior walls and base, showing no mold, rust, or damage.

risks.risk: Lid seal may be compromised due to warping and damage
risks.proof: Photo of the lid seal from the side, showing continuity and tight fit.

proof_requests: Video or photo of the freezer running with the lid closed, showing temperature inside.
Close-up photo of the interior walls and base to check for mold or damage.
Photo of the lid seal from the side to check for damage or gaps.
Photo of the power cord and plug to check for damage.
response.reason: The freezer's condition is visibly poor with damaged lid and dirty interior, contradicting the seller's claim of 'excellent condition'. The brand 'Skyrun' is not visible, so identity is by type. Functionality and internal condition are unknown, which are critical for pricing. Proof of working condition and interior state is required before pricing.
